paragraphs: See the entry R' Asi bar Nakan; he is a Tanna, as in [Bava Batra 121a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.121a.2).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage reads Rabbi Yosi bar Natan. He has learned a baraita and goes to ask Rav Sheshet how to explain it. Hyman classifies the person in his notice as a Tanna.

[Heilprin’s Asi bar Natan notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=617&lang=en) refers to [his Yosi bar Natan entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1969&lang=en), which cites this episode. Hyman uses Nakan in both names.
